# The best CRM for contact management

The best contact management software helps you combine communications tracking, customer preferences and help desk tickets in one centralized tool shared across your business.

## What do contact managers need from a sales CRM platform?

The right customer relationship management (CRM) for contact management improves your overall customer experience and sales performance through enhanced efficiency, transparency and more valuable interactions, all at an affordable price.

##### Access real-time data from anywhere

Update, share and analyze data entry on any device with Pipedrive’s cloud-based contact management CRM system and mobile app

##### Sync customer data

Collect customer information from imports, e-commerce sites, email, social media platforms, web forms and SMS to gain a wider view of your contacts in one contact management tool

##### Foster effective team collaboration

Share knowledge across teams with a centralized contact and project management system that lets you tag and filter information, assign tasks and send reports

##### Personalize your touchpoints

Understand each contact’s history with your organization to help you develop more relevant touchpoints across the customer lifecycle

##### Leverage valuable information

Leverage insights from your contact records and management database to tap into your customers’ buying power and refine forecasting

##### Deliver a superior customer experience

Customize your entire customer journey and automate workflows that improve how you interact with your prospects, leads and customers

Dealing with large amounts of customer contact information can be overwhelming for large and small business contact managers alike. It’s often difficult to track contact information and ensure you capitalize on every opportunity.

With Pipedrive’s contact management software, your sales managers can streamline their team’s workflow and delegate tasks.

# London

Be a part of Pipedrive London’s growth story.

Join our dynamic team in this iconic city.

See open positions

## About us

Our London office is home to a fun and close-knit team of 30+ Pipedrivers. Over the years, we’ve tried it all, from co-working spaces and private offices to going fully remote. In March 2024, we found our new home in Holborn at Uncommon, right in the heart of London.

This small but mighty team represents almost every Pipedrive department (engineering, we’re saving a seat for you) and reflects the global nature of our company. We’re proud of the mix of nationalities, languages, skills and experiences that come together here.

Many of our executive team are also based in London, which means leadership is always close by for the moments that matter.

## Our traditions

Tea, biscuits and big ideas – that’s how many of our best conversations start. While coffee may be serious business at Pipedrive, London proudly leads with tea. You’ll also find cake on the table more often than not, from themed celebration bakes to treats during our weekly “Cake & Catch-up” or twice-monthly All Hands.

Our office culture blends energy and warmth. The buzz of our sales team provides its own soundtrack, and we keep things moving with gym classes, walk-and-talk meetings and the occasional lunchtime museum trip. We also love our rooftop terrace – perfect for summer drinks, team chats and soaking up the skyline.

Dogs are always welcome, and we’ve named our meeting rooms after our favorite local pubs, a small nod to British culture and a big part of what makes this space feel like home.

## Where you’ll find us

You’ll find us in Holborn at Uncommon, a creative and modern workspace in central London. From here, it’s easy to explore everything the city has to offer – Covent Garden, Soho and countless cafés, museums and parks are just steps away.

Our office space offers a balance of comfort and energy. The on-site café is ideal for grabbing coffee or lunch, and our rooftop terrace is a team favorite when the sun’s out. Inside, the space supports collaboration and focus – whether you’re deep in a strategy session or catching up with a teammate over tea.

There’s room here to do your best work and enjoy the people around you. Whether it’s brainstorming over biscuits, heading out for a walk or joining a spontaneous pub night, our London office makes work feel genuinely good.

## Meet our team

I’ve never felt that Monday morning feeling at Pipedrive. The people here are some of the best I’ve worked with. We have fun, work hard and actually like each other. Weird right? Plus, the opportunities for growth mean I never get complacent. If you’re looking for a job that stretches you and a company that really values its employees, Pipedrive is the place for you!

Hallo! Welcome to our Berlin office, located in the European capital for innovation and digitization.

See open positions

Welcome to Pipedrive Germany, our vibrant new hub right in the heart of Berlin!

## About us

Welcome to our vibrant office in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida! We opened our doors in August 2019, and as our team has grown, we relocated in September 2023 to better serve our community and customers. title: Prague | Jobs

# Prague

Ahoj! Welcome to Pipedrive Prague, a development center in the beautiful heart of Europe.

See open positions

## About us

Our Prague office is a dynamic engineering hub buzzing with diversity, culture and innovation. Home to 30+ talented teammates from more than ten countries, it’s a space designed to spark ideas and foster collaboration.

Movie-themed meeting rooms – including a Harry Potter fan favorite – make it a vibrant spot for team off-sites, attracting colleagues from across the globe.

Beyond work, we actively support Prague’s tech, data and HR communities, hosting regular meetups to share knowledge and inspire the next generation of talent.

## Our traditions

Our small, agile Prague team thrives on collaboration and innovation. A favorite tradition of ours is Lightning Talks, which began here in Prague to give people a safe, informal space to practice presenting. They’re optional, relaxed and always leave us feeling a little more inspired.

We take work-life balance seriously, with flexible hours that cater to night owls and early birds alike. Our office vibe is fun and welcoming, from foosball matches and ready-to-ride skateboards to carefully chosen coffee and tea, with a touch of Estonian flair from our slippers and sauna.

Connection is important at our Prague office, and we see it in the moments we share. Communal breakfasts, pickle-making and countless self-organized events capture the close-knit spirit that defines our team. We swap tips in our Prague-only Slack channels (prague-beauty, prague-investing and more), and when we clock out, you’ll find us belting out tunes during karaoke nights.

## Where you’ll find us

Our journey began in a co-working space, but in March 2020, we moved into a new office designed specifically for us. It’s located in a thriving Prague neighborhood – Karlín – and we’re sure we’re the first office in Prague with a sauna! We really enjoy the enchanting atmosphere here, which combines history and the pulse of modern business – complete with Harry Potter and Narnia-themed rooms that make work feel just a little more magical.

Our new home, Praga Studios, was recognized as one of the greenest buildings in the world. You can admire our beehives while drinking your coffee on the rooftop terrace with an amazing city view. Or, if you have green thumbs, try gardening right next to the building!

## Meet our team

People are at the heart of everything we do. I get to work with brilliant, fun colleagues in a culture that values internal drive and supporting each other as one team. It’s an incredible place to grow, collaborate, and make a real difference. Now, even more so than ever, with AI transforming how we and our customers work, we have a real chance to shape the future of the CRM industry.

# Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Engineering

Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 4,700 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity & Inclusion (DEI): Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive.

## The Senior Enterprise Engineer opportunity

Statsig is building an Enterprise Engineering team for engineers who want unusually direct ownership of high-stakes customer outcomes. Like a Forward Deployed Engineering team, Enterprise Engineering works extremely close to customers and tackles the technical problems that matter most to them.

The difference is the scope of ownership. Forward Deployed Engineering is often concentrated around implementation or onboarding; Enterprise Engineering is responsible for a customer’s technical success throughout the entire customer journey. You’ll stay close as needs evolve, answering questions, investigating across the stack, identifying root causes, shipping fixes and features, and remaining accountable through resolution.

This is a software engineering role with a tight customer feedback loop. It is ideal for a pragmatic generalist, especially someone with backend or infrastructure depth who enjoys ambiguous problems, production systems, fast decisions, and immediate impact.

## What you’ll do

* Serve on the engineering front line in Unthread, our Slack aggregation and workflow layer, for key customer accounts.
* Answer technical questions by reading the code, tracing behavior, inspecting production signals, and building a clear explanation, not by forwarding the thread.
* Diagnose and fix bugs, then validate the outcome with the customer.
* Design and implement product or platform features when doing so is the fastest, highest-quality way to solve the customer’s problem.
* Act as the engineering point of contact for urgent issues in key customer accounts’ Slack channels, coordinating the response while retaining technical ownership.
* Represent engineering in customer office hours and, for selected accounts, recurring weekly meetings.

At Amplitude, millions of developers instrument their products to understand how users behave. The first code they write with Amplitude is almost always through an SDK. That means our SDKs are **not just integrations, they are the developer experience of Amplitude itself.** We're building a new kind of SDK team:

Most companies hire SDK engineers per language.

We don't.

We're recruiting **AI-assisted SDK wizards**, engineers who:

* learn new languages quickly
* use AI to accelerate development
* build tooling to scale SDK maintenance

* Own developer experience - improve how developers integrate with Amplitude
* Optimize SDK for latency, performance, bundle size, resource load
* Create external-facing agents that take advantage of the signals collected by our SDKs
* Build integrations with third parties
* Drive high engineering standards while knowing when speed beats perfection.
* Create a culture where people love the work, move fast, and deliver real outcomes.

* Experience building SDKs, APIs, or developer platforms.
